title: Optimystix Entertainment India IPO Details
intro:
Optimystix Entertainment IPO is a book build issue of ₹108.50 crores. The issue is a combination of fresh issue of 0.50 crore shares aggregating to ₹87.50 crores and offer for sale of 0.12 crore shares aggregating to ₹21.00 crores.

Optimystix Entertainment IPO opens for subscription on Aug 7, 2026 and closes on Aug 11, 2026. The allotment for the Optimystix Entertainment IPO is expected to be finalized on Aug 12, 2026. Optimystix Entertainment IPO will list on the NSE SME with a tentative listing date fixed as Aug 14, 2026.

Optimystix Entertainment IPO is set issue price band at ₹166 to ₹175 per share. The lot size for an application is 800 shares. The minimum amount of investment required by an individual investor (retail) is ₹2,80,000 (1,600 shares) (based on upper price). The minimum lot size for investment in HNI is 3 lots (2,400 shares), amounting to ₹4,20,000.

LSI Financial Services Pvt.Ltd. is the book running lead manager and Maashitla Securities Pvt.Ltd. is the registrar of the issue. The Market Maker of the company is Mansi Share & Stock Broking Pvt.Ltd.

Refer to Optimystix Entertainment IPO RHP for detailed Information.

paragraphs: Incorporated in 2000, Optimystix Entertainment India Limited is engaged in the business of content creation and production for television, films, and digital platforms. The company has produced over 150 television shows, delivering more than 7,500 hours of original programming across major national broadcasters.

It operates across both fiction and non-fiction formats, with popular shows such as Laughter Chefs, Baalveer, Rising Star, Saas Bina Sasural, and Ladies Special. The company’s franchises in comedy, crime, and children’s genres rank among the longest-running formats in the Indian entertainment industry.

Optimystix has earned more than 60 industry awards for its creative excellence and continues to maintain strong relationships with broadcasters, studios, and OTT platforms, ensuring recurring business and a diversified revenue base.
Its notable film productions include OMG 2 (starring Akshay Kumar, Pankaj Tripathi, and Yami Gautam), The Diplomat (starring John Abraham and Sadia Khateeb), and Khel Khel Mein.
As of July 30, 2026, the company employs 38 full-time professionals.

faqs.question: How to apply in Optimystix Entertainment IPO through Zerodha?
faqs.answer: Zerodha customers can apply online in Optimystix Entertainment IPO using UPI as a payment gateway. Zerodha customers can apply in Optimystix Entertainment IPO by login into Zerodha Console (back office) and submitting an IPO application form. Steps to apply in Optimystix Entertainment IPO through Zerodha Visit the Zerodha website and login to Console. Go to Portfolio and click the IPOs link. Go to the ' Optimystix Entertainment IPO ' row and click the 'Bid' button. Enter your UPI ID, Quantity, and Price. Submit IPO application form. Visit the UPI App (net banking or BHIM ) to approve the mandate. Visit Zerodha IPO Application Process Review for more detail.

faqs.question: When Optimystix Entertainment IPO will open?
faqs.answer: The Optimystix Entertainment IPO opens on Fri, Aug 7, 2026 and closes on Tue, Aug 11, 2026.

faqs.question: What is the lot size of Optimystix Entertainment IPO?
faqs.answer: Optimystix Entertainment IPO lot size is 800 , and the minimum amount required for application is ₹2,80,000 , with 2 lots being the minimum application size .

faqs.question: How to apply for Optimystix Entertainment IPO?
faqs.answer: You can apply in Optimystix Entertainment IPO online using either UPI or ASBA as a payment method. ASBA IPO application is available in the net banking of your bank account. UPI IPO Application is offered by brokers who don't offer banking services. Read more detail about applying IPO online through Zerodha , Upstox , 5Paisa , Nuvama , HDFC Bank , and SBI Bank .

faqs.question: When is Optimystix Entertainment IPO allotment?
faqs.answer: The finalization of Basis of Allotment for Optimystix Entertainment IPO will be done on Wednesday, August 12, 2026 , and the allotted shares will be credited to your demat account by Thu, Aug 13, 2026 . Check the Optimystix Entertainment IPO allotment status .

faqs.answer: The Optimystix Entertainment IPO listing date is not yet announced. The tentative date of listing is Fri, Aug 14, 2026 .
